messages:
tom: heads-up — ran a HF->Redwood convert of `mistral-mini-qa` and hit a weird partial-shard + tokenizer mismatch. convertbot exited with a 403 on shard_00002 and then later we ended up with duplicated <|sep|> special tokens in the tokenizer.json. anyone seen this? :eyes:

convertbot: automated retry log — attempted download https://huggingface.co/org/mistral-mini-qa/resolve/abcd1234/shard_00002.safetensors -> 403 Forbidden (3/3). Aborting convert.

maya: ugh. was the convert run with a pinned revision? sometimes HF CDN revs cause presigned URLs to expire if we re-resolve mid-convert. what was the CLI command you used?

tom: `redwood-convert --src hf://org/mistral-mini-qa:abcd1234 --out /mnt/models/mistral-mini-qa --quant int8`

li-wei: two things we saw recently: 1) convertlib v0.12.2 applies weight-key-rename mapping before shard-merge, which can cause duplicate weight names when shards have overlapping namespaces (broken upstream shard split). 2) our revpin fallback currently prefers `revision` field but HF sometimes returns `sha` in the manifest; if the presigned URL expires we try to re-resolve and get a different shard ordering temporarily. combined -> partial downloads + key renames => tokenizer/embed dim mismatch.

jason: can you paste the small snippet of the tokenizer.json and the convert log around the final tokenizer write? if embeddings end up with wrong dims we see special token duplication or token id collisions.

tom: paste below (trimmed):
```
[INFO] writing tokenizer to /mnt/models/mistral-mini-qa/tokenizer.json
[INFO] saved vocab_size=50288
[WARN] found duplicate special token "<|sep|>" at ids [50287,50288]
[ERROR] embedding matrix shape mismatch: expected (50288, 4096) got (50289, 4096)
```

li-wei: yep that's consistent. duplicate token id means one shard added the token mapping after a failed download/merge. the 403 likely left a half-written shard file and the subsequent merge read inconsistent index.

maya: quick workaround: re-run convert with `--download-only` then verify all `_index.json` entries exist and all shard files are size-consistent before merge: `redwood-convert --src hf://... --out /tmp/mistral-download --download-only` then `ls -l` and `sha256sum` the shards. if any 0-byte or truncated file, re-download.

jason: another dev workaround: `redwood-convert --no-merge-shards` then run our safe-merge script that validates weight-key uniqueness before merging. example: `python tools/safe_merge_shards.py --dir /tmp/mistral-download` — it reports duplicate keys and aborts.

convertbot: automated note: the convert job id `cb-8d7f` was marked failed and retried once by scheduler. No further automatic retries due to auth 403.

erin: action items: 1) open GH issue against convertlib to change rename order (apply rename after merge) and add unit test with synthetic overlapping shard namespaces. 2) add revpin fallback to also consult `sha`/`commit_hash` keys in HF manifest before re-resolving presigned urls. 3) ship emergency patch to redwood-convert pinned to convertlib v0.12.3 (contains hotfix).

li-wei: I'll file the GH issue with repro steps and attach the trimmed logs. for the hotfix, jason can you test v0.12.3 on CI? thanks. :thumbsup:

jason: will run quick smoke (convert -> validation script) and report back in this thread within ~30m. if green we'll roll patch to staging and re-run customer bring-up.

tom: thanks all. leaving the failed model dir intact at /mnt/models/failed/mistral-mini-qa for postmortem. will try the `--download-only` flow now.

erin: noted. I'll also ping @ops to check if there were any upstream HF rate-limit events around the timestamps in the logs.

maya: follow-up: if anyone hits this and needs a manual fix right away — run: `python tools/fix_tokenizer_ids.py --tokenizer tokenizer.json --embeds embedding.npy` it will detect duplicated special tokens and remap ids to the highest unused id, then patch embedding rows accordingly. it's a bandaid but works for quick demos.

tom: confirmed `--download-only` showed shard_00002.safetensors file size 0 (download truncated). re-downloaded manually, re-ran convert with `--no-merge-shards` + safe-merge -> success. model validated on eval harness. :party_popper:
